text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Smart Falcon and I are walking
through
the shopping district on our way
back from an
outing, when...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's this shop! This really takes me
back!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You see, before my first ever street

performance...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I came here by myself to have a ham
katsu while I
prayed to get over my
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was an important moment on my way
to
becoming an Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! Why don't we get a ham
katsu since
we're here?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want you to taste the flavor I remember
so
well! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We buy two ham katsus and eat them
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, yum! It's just as crunchy as I
remember!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Pffft! Ahaha! You look like a hamster
with all that
food stuffed in your mouth!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But I'm super happy you like it so
much! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...That was great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit strange, though... It could just
be my
imagination, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I think it was even better than before!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I think it was even better than before!
choice_data_list: お店も努力してるんだろうな
お店も努力してるんだろうね
choice_data_list_en: Maybe because the two of us ate it together?
The shop must be working hard, too.
The shop must be working hard, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! They say food tastes better
when you
share it with someone, right?
choice_data_list: お店も努力してるんだろうな
お店も努力してるんだろうね
choice_data_list_en: Maybe because the two of us ate it together?
The shop must be working hard, too.
The shop must be working hard, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But in my case, it's not because of just
anyone...
It's because I shared it with
you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. If you don't know, I'm not telling!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But if it's okay with you, there is one
little favor
I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want you to always remember having
ham katsu
with me today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know it might not seem like a big deal,
but
memories like this add up...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And all together, they become a great
source of
motivation for achieving your
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course! ☆ After all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what fuels me to chase my
dream
of becoming the cutest top
Umadol! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we take a leisurely stroll
back to the
academy beneath the
setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see! So you're saying this is the result
of their
dedication to their craft?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If even a memorable flavor like that can
change, I
need to be able to change
too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I want to become the cutest top
Umadol, then
I'll have to work even
harder!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Thanks, Trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm feeling pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know today's supposed to be a rest
day, but I
want to do some extra training
right away!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thanks a lot!
choice_data_list: 帰り道でメニューを考えるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll plan the training menu on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'd like something I can do before
curfew.
Something crisp, but also with
some real meat to
it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like the ham katsu we had! Now,
let's get
moving, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon hurries me along and we
end up
running back to campus beneath
the setting sun.
